replacements.<strong>Lectura:</strong> PagedAttention: Reading: PagedAttention or a paged KV cache changes the relationship between logical blocks and physical memory. Continuous batching changes the set of active requests on each iteration. Capacity links the two: finishing a request releases state and can enable another admission. Offload adds another tier; it does not turn slower memory into free VRAM.
